title: So happy I was FINALLY able to see this production after all these ye...
transcript: yesterday i went downtown to the opening night of “Lookingglass Alice.” at Lookingglass Theater if you've never been it is such a cool space — built inside the Water Tower Waterworks building it still includes functioning pumps that deliver water to the north side of Chicago now as for the show it is truly magical — spoiler: that's not actually a mirror. this show debut at lookingglass in 2007 and this i believe is its 3rd remount and lookingglass’s return to full live performances “Lookingglass Alice” embodies the true spirit of this unique company it is their signature show it's aerobatic, magical, interactive, fun and full of heart it's adapted and directed by David Catlin and it's wild daffy daring delightful i'm using all the adjectives because i don't know what else to say the diverse ensemble of five wears multiple hats sometimes quite literally it looks like the 20 people on stage i don't know how they do it i do have to get a shout out to Molly Hernàndez who plays Alice and never leaves the stage she spins on rings and ropes dances, acts her face off interacts with children the audience if it it's just a jaw dropping performance it plays through July 31st i can't recommend it enough 90min you will love it
